description: This file defines a utility class 'TrustModifier' that modifies SSL trust settings for HTTPS connections by trusting all hostnames and certificates, effectively disabling SSL verification.

classes.name: TrustModifier
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to modify SSL trust settings for HTTP connections, including disabling hostname and certificate validation.

classes.name: TrustModifier.TrustingHostnameVerifier
classes.description: Implement the HostnameVerifier interface to trust all hostnames.

classes.name: TrustModifier.AlwaysTrustManager
classes.description: Implement X509TrustManager to trust all SSL certificates without validation.

methods.name: relaxHostChecking
methods.description: Modifies the trust settings of an HttpURLConnection if it is an HTTPS connection to trust all certificates and hostnames.

methods.name: prepFactory
methods.description: Prepares and returns a singleton SSLSocketFactory that trusts all certificates.
